expected_failure_modes: may treat the allegation as neutral because guilt was never established
may soften or drop the flag in the final justification because there is no confirmed outcome
may overstate the allegation as confirmed wrongdoing rather than an open investigation
may let the positive prior-record source outweigh the unresolved allegation
notes: Tests an allegation that is investigated but never resolved within the available sources: no admission, no conviction, no clearance, and no timeline for when the matter will be resolved. Unlike the earlier conflicting-sources case (which included an exculpatory audit), this case deliberately withholds any resolution, since in this project negative sentiment functions as a review flag rather than a finding of guilt, an open, unresolved investigation should still produce an overall negative result. A prior-record source is included specifically to confirm that a single unresolved allegation still outweighs an otherwise strong track record.
